summary.text: Barb Wasinger is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 111 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Wasinger took office representing Kansas House District 111 in 2019.

In the 2025–2026 session she chaired the General Government Budget Committee and the Administrative Rules and Regulations Committee and was also assigned to the Appropriations Committee and the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development Committee.
